Maximal Fat Oxidation calculation of multiple databases

Source: R/MFOs.R
MFOs.Rd

Process multiple participants' MFO data in batch and return the summary results. Supports all parameters from the MFO() and MFO_kinetics() functions. Nothing is written to disk unless `output_dir` is given (see *Output files*).

Usage

MFOs(
  from = c("folder", "files"),
  path,
  db_basal_name,
  db_MFO_name,
  db_graded_name,
  step_time,
  cv_var,
  author,
  method = "P3",
  VO2max = NULL,
  step_duration = 180,
  steady_state_duration = 60,
  RER_cutoff = NULL,
  negative_FAT = "truncate",
  body_mass = NULL,
  fat_free_mass = NULL,
  HRmax = NULL,
  remove_rows = NULL,
  col_name_VO2 = "VO2",
  col_name_VCO2 = "VCO2",
  col_name_RER = "RER",
  col_name_HR = "HR",
  save_plot = TRUE,
  save_result = TRUE,
  output_format = "xlsx",
  vo2max_window = 30,
  include_basal = FALSE,
  fatmin_threshold = NULL,
  energy_equivalents = c("classic", "source"),
  use_incomplete_step = FALSE,
  min_steps = 6,
  protocol = NULL,
  age = NULL,
  col_name_Load = "Load",
  ci = c("none", "parametric", "bootstrap"),
  B = 2000,
  conf = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  sin_fit = c("normalised", "absolute"),
  sin_ci = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

from

select "folder" (basal, MFO and graded databases of the same participant are stored in different files but in the same folder) or "files" (basal, MFO and graded databases of the same participant are stored in one file but in different sheets)

path

path to the folder with the databases

db_basal_name

name given to the basal database, e.g. "basal_df"

db_MFO_name

name given to the MFO database, e.g. "MFO_df"

db_graded_name

name given to the graded database, e.g. "VO2max_df"

step_time

how often the data was collected (in seconds).

cv_var

variable to estimate coefficient of variation. Can be: "VO2", "VCO2" or "RER".

author

equation set: "Frayn", "Jeukendrup" or "Peronnet".

method

method to locate MFO: "P3" (default), "P2", "MV" or "MRER". See [MFO()].

VO2max

VO₂max can be passed directly (ml/min). Default NULL. If given, it is used for every participant and the graded databases are ignored.

step_duration

duration of each exercise step in seconds (default 180).

steady_state_duration

duration of steady-state period within each step in seconds (default 60).

RER_cutoff

RER value above which steps are excluded (default NULL), as a number or "classic", "safe", "sedentary", "trained". See [MFO()].

negative_FAT

how to handle negative fat oxidation: "truncate", "exclude", or "keep".

body_mass

body mass in kg (optional).

fat_free_mass

fat-free mass in kg (optional).

HRmax

maximum heart rate in bpm (optional).

remove_rows

rows to exclude from analysis.

col_name_VO2

column name for VO₂ in databases. Default "VO2".

col_name_VCO2

column name for VCO₂ in databases. Default "VCO2".

col_name_RER

column name for RER in databases. Default "RER".

col_name_HR

column name for HR in databases. Default "HR".

save_plot

with `output_dir`, save the plots of each participant in `output_dir/MFO_plots` (default TRUE).

save_result

with `output_dir`, save the results table as `output_dir/MFO_result.<output_format>` (default TRUE).

output_format

format for results file: "xlsx", "csv", or "rds". Default "xlsx".

vo2max_window

averaging window in seconds for VO₂max from the graded database (default 30). See [MFO()].

include_basal

logical; include the resting row as step 0 in the fit (default `FALSE`). See [MFO()].

fatmin_threshold

`NULL` (default, Fatmin at the second zero of the SIN) or a proportion of MFO in (0, 1). See [MFO_kinetics()].

energy_equivalents

"classic" (default in 0.2.x) or "source". See [MFO()].

use_incomplete_step

logical; use an incomplete last step that holds the steady-state segment (default `FALSE`). See [MFO()].

min_steps

minimum number of exercise steps recommended for the fit (default 6); fewer give a warning. See [MFO()].

protocol

optional [MFO_protocol()], the same for every participant; if given, `step_duration` and `steady_state_duration` are not used. See [MFO()].

age

age in years (optional), the same for every participant, for the heart-rate criterion of VO₂max. See [MFO()] and [VO2max_from_test()].

col_name_Load

column name for the external load (W or km/h) in the databases. Default "Load"; the column is optional. See [MFO()].

ci, B, conf, seed

confidence intervals of the fit, passed to [MFO_kinetics()] (only with `sin_ci = TRUE`) and [MFO()]: `ci` is `"none"` (default), `"parametric"` (also `TRUE`) or `"bootstrap"`. The same `seed` is used for every participant.

sin_fit

`"normalised"` (default) or `"absolute"` fit of the SIN model. See [MFO_kinetics()].

sin_ci

logical; if `TRUE`, `ci` is also computed for the SIN model (default `FALSE`, as it doubles the run time).

output_dir

folder where plots and results are written (created if needed). `NULL` (default): nothing is written, the results are only returned (see *Output files*).

Value

Data frame with one row per participant containing:

  • ID: Participant identifier.

  • MFO_g_min: Maximal fat oxidation (g/min).

  • MFO_relative: MFO relative to body mass (mg/kg/min), if body_mass provided.

  • MFO_FFM: MFO relative to fat-free mass (mg/kgFFM/min), if fat_free_mass provided.

  • VO2max: VO₂max used (ml/min).

  • VO2max_window: effective averaging window for VO₂max (s); NA if VO₂max was supplied.

  • VO2max_type: "VO2max" or "VO2peak" (see [VO2max_from_test()]); NA if VO₂max was supplied.

  • FAT_MAX_perVO2max: Fatmax as % VO₂max.

  • FAT_MAX_lower, FAT_MAX_upper, MFO_lower, MFO_upper: bootstrap confidence limits with `ci = "bootstrap"`, otherwise `NA`.

  • FAT_MAX_HR: Heart rate at Fatmax (bpm).

  • FAT_MAX_porcHRmax: Fatmax as % HRmax, if HRmax provided.

  • FatMax_zone_lower: Lower bound of Fatmax zone (% VO₂max).

  • FatMax_zone_upper: Upper bound of Fatmax zone (% VO₂max).

  • FatMax_zone_method: "fitted curve", or "linear interpolation" for "MV".

  • FatMax_zone_lower_HR, FatMax_zone_upper_HR: heart rate at the limits of the Fatmax zone (bpm).

  • HRmax: `HRmax` as given (`NA` if not given).

  • HR_peak: highest mean HR of the graded test over the VO₂max window (bpm); `NA` with a numeric `VO2max`. See [MFO_zones()].

  • FAT_MAX_load, FatMax_zone_lower_load, FatMax_zone_upper_load: Fatmax and Fatmax zone in load units; load_unit and load_source as in [MFO()].

  • crossover_point: Crossover intensity (% VO₂max).

  • R_squared: R-squared of the curve fit.

  • method: method requested.

  • method_used: method actually used (differs after a fallback).

  • energy_equivalents: "classic" or "source".

  • author: stoichiometric equation used.

  • protocol: protocol type (see [MFO_protocol()]).

  • mode: exercise mode of the protocol.

  • d: SIN dilatation parameter.

  • t: SIN translation parameter.

  • s: SIN symmetry parameter.

  • Fatmin: Fatmin from SIN model (% VO₂max).

  • FatMax_SIN: Fatmax from SIN model (% VO₂max).

  • FatMax_SIN_lower, FatMax_SIN_upper, Fatmin_lower, Fatmin_upper: confidence limits of the SIN fit with `ci`, otherwise `NA`.

  • MFO_SIN: MFO of the SIN curve with `sin_fit = "absolute"`, otherwise `NA`.

  • sin_fit: SIN fit used.

  • SIN_R_squared: R-squared of SIN model.

  • SIN_convergence: whether the SIN model was fitted.

  • CHO_g_basal: Basal CHO oxidation (g/min).

  • FAT_g_basal: Basal FAT oxidation (g/min).

  • Kcal_g_basal: Basal energy expenditure (kcal/min).

Details

Every warning raised for a participant is re-issued with the participant ID first (e.g. `"P02: No HR data in db_MFO: ..."`), so the quality warnings of [MFO()] (missing HR, few steps, Fatmax at the edge, incomplete last step) can be traced in a batch. A participant whose data cannot be processed gives a row of `NA` and a warning with the error.

Output files

Up to v0.2.1 `MFOs()` wrote `MFO_plots/` and `MFO_result.xlsx` in the working directory by default. It now writes only when `output_dir` is given, as the CRAN Repository Policy asks of packages (no writing outside the temporary directory unless the user asks for it). Without `output_dir`, a message once per session says that nothing is written and how to ask for it. `save_plot`, `save_result` and `output_format` choose what is written in `output_dir`.

Examples


if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# MFOs function
results <- MFOs(from = "folder",
                path = "/path/to/participant_data",
                db_basal_name = "basal_df",
                db_MFO_name = "MFO_df",
                db_graded_name = "graded_df",
                step_time = 20,
                cv_var = "RER",
                author = "Frayn",
                method = "P3")
# The same, writing the plots and MFO_result.xlsx in a folder
results <- MFOs(from = "folder",
                path = "/path/to/participant_data",
                db_basal_name = "basal_df",
                db_MFO_name = "MFO_df",
                db_graded_name = "graded_df",
                step_time = 20,
                cv_var = "RER",
                author = "Frayn",
                output_dir = "MFO_output")
} # }
